contrasts.primary_contrast: gap_NLL = (NLL_adapted_complement - NLL_initial_complement) - (NLL_adapted_bank - NLL_initial_bank); compare gap_B3 - gap_B4 within seed
contrasts.secondary_metrics: forward KL(initial teacher || adapted) separately for bank/complement and its analogous initial-subtracted gap; do not assume computed baseline KL is numerically zero
contrasts.direction: positive NLL gap means relative bank fit exceeds complement fit; it is not by itself proof of harmful forgetting or a complete causal mechanism
contrasts.independence_limits: Complement excludes bank exactly but belongs to the same frozen teacher generation pool, which participated in statistics/selection. It is not a new independent heldout test. Common generation/training seed differences persist across the three paired seeds.
contrasts.selection_policy: No tuning, bank changes, main-model selection or official test exclusion based on this exploratory outcome; final and best are separate strata
